thread:
alex: Quick proposal — let's codify a graceful 'degradation exit' for runtime pins. Too many ad-hoc rollbacks lately. Suggest criteria + runbook so deploybot can help enforce.
maya: what do you mean by 'degradation exit'? new automatic rollback rule or just ops playbook?
alex: both. proposal (short):
- metric triggers (auto): >=3% absolute increase in OOMs OR >=20% p95 latency uplift sustained for 30m
- telemetry threshold: require >=1000 sampled tokens/min in the canary region to avoid noisy signals
- manual override: SRE/Release lead can abort the auto action with reason logged
- rollforward path: soft-unpin -> observe -> staged rollout (5% 10m -> 25% 1h -> 100%)
- fallback routing check: confirm fallback model latency/cost before auto-rollback

sam: add another automated condition: if error-rate (5xx) increases by >=5% and fallback model p95 is at least 15% better, then prefer auto-rollback. saves time during clear regressions.

linh: small infra note: eu-canary currently ~70% util, warming caches matter. recommend a KV-cache prefill step before any soft-unpin, otherwise we'll see a transient latency spike that looks like regression.
deploybot: [automated] runtime pin applied: runtime v3.2.1 pinned -> model-group llama3x-eu (initiated by @alex) at 2024-06-21T15:12:57Z. tag: memory-regression

maya: ok — can we also include explicit runbook commands to attach to the deploybot schedule? e.g.,
```
/deploy unpin runtime v3.2.1 --target=canary --mode=soft --duration=10m
/deploy cancel soft-unpin 1717779000
```
alex: yes. observability checklist to attach to the scheduled job:
- p95 latency (endpoint)
- error-rate (5xx)
- memory OOM count
- KV cache hit rate
- sample-gen QA on a 20-seed eval set

ops-runner: note: if soft-unpin causes routing to hosted-variant, cost delta ~1.4x. Need ops/cost approval for any pin >24h.

sam: i'll draft a concise release-note blurb and ping product. also creating a tiny eval set to watch hallucination/regression signals in next 2 hours.

maya: ack. telemetry gating: i'll run a pre-check at 10:15 UTC. if green, we let deploybot execute soft-unpin at 10:30 UTC. if not, hold and escalate.

alex: decision: adopt these criteria for this pin. action items: @sam = release note, @linh = KV prefill, @maya = telemetry check, @ops-runner = cost OK. :thumbsup:
deploybot: [info] scheduled soft-unpin: 1717779000 (10:30 UTC) — cron -> will execute unless cancelled. To cancel: `/deploy cancel soft-unpin 1717779000`.

linh: prefill started, ETA ~12m.

sam: release note draft -> https://internal.redwood/release-notes/llama3x-runtime-pin-digest (cc @product)

maya: telemetry pre-check complete — p95 within 2% of baseline, OOMs unchanged, KV hit stable. green to proceed unless anyone objects.

alex: no objections, proceed with scheduled soft-unpin. :party-parrot:

ops-runner: cost approved for up to 48h if we need extended time to monitor.
deploybot: [done] executed soft-unpin at 1717779000. Traffic stepdown: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Observability snapshots attached to runbook.

alex: closing loop: keep this thread as canonical reference for runtime-pin exit heuristics. we'll iterate after this canary completes. thanks all.
